name: Budapest Comic Con
blurb: Hungary's largest pop-culture event, bringing international film and TV stars together with comic book writers and artists in Budapest.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'MAGYARORSZÁG LEGNAGYOBB GEEK RENDEZVÉNYE! 2027. MÁRCIUS 6-7.' and 'Találkozzunk újra 2027. március 6-án és 7-én'

notes: Official site text gives dates only (March 6-7, 2027), no venue name; third-party news sites (not used as source) mention Hungexpo but this is unconfirmed by the con's own pages, so venue is left blank. Verify pass (2026-10-05): reversed to stale -- a Feb 7, 2026 news article (pcguru.hu) confirms Christopher Judge, one of the 65 picked guests, was booked for Budapest Comic Con's March 21-22, 2026 edition ('Judge a rendezvény mindkét napján, március 21-én és 22-én is jelen lesz'), not the March 6-7, 2027 edition, and the szineszek/kepregenyalkotok pages carry no 2027-specific marker, so the whole 65-guest roster (both pages) is last year's lineup; cleared to none-yet.
